newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia to test surface-to-surface missile.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia to test surface-to-surface missile.

text.p: Saudi Arabia will fire a surface-to-surface missile on Saturday at a new military firing range in the kingdom, Saudi state television said on Friday.

It said Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan would fire the missile at the inauguration of a military complex in al-Kharj, 100 km (60 miles) southeast of Riyadh, which includes a firing range. It gave no further details about the missile.
Saudi Arabia has an ambitious armament programme and major arms contracts with Britain, the United States and France.
